_note:
Synthetic example showing the expected structure of an Audience 
Intelligence output inside Carol Marketing OS. This is not a real patient 
profile and must not be treated as prevalence data or as a substitute for 
current internal research.
subject:
Women seeking gynecologic care because symptoms or findings are 
affecting quality of life or creating uncertainty, and who value understanding, 
investigation, individualization and a concrete care path.

strategic_status.note:
This subject reflects the current ICP direction from Marketing 
Core. It is broader than any single clinical segment.

examples: symptom combinations that may change investigation

segments.research_note:
Strategically relevant but historically undercaptured in 
the current internal questionnaire. Do not infer prevalence from the existing 
questionnaire alone.

patient_needs.description:
Understand what may be happening, how symptoms or findings 
fit together, and what deserves investigation.

Move from uncertainty or diagnosis toward an appropriate 
and concrete treatment path.

Recover function, quality of life, confidence or wellbeing 
affected by the clinical problem.

voice_of_patient_examples: saber realmente o que eu tenho
quero saber se minha parte hormonal tem a ver com os sintomas
limitations:
The questionnaire was not designed to estimate the number of physicians 
previously consulted.
Weight and body-composition goals were historically undercaptured.

Questionnaire respondents are not automatically representative of every 
lead or paying patient.

signals:
Meta conversations showed substantially more price-first openings than 
organic conversations in the analyzed sample.
Insurance questions occurred in both Meta and organic conversations.

A conversation detector found more confirmed appointments in the 
organic group than in the Meta group, but this is not equivalent to verified 
attendance or true business conversion.
limitations: Raw CRM conversation evidence is preferred over automated CRM labels.
Cliente IO AI classifications must not be used as ground truth.
Confirmed appointment in conversation does not prove attendance.
Quoted price does not prove revenue.

The current CRM sample should not be used to claim that Meta Ads does 
not work.

signals:
Clinical competence was not the focus of the identified negative 
operational criticism.

The small amount of criticism identified concerned older operational 
communication or secretarial experience.
limitations:
Public reviews are self-selected and must not be interpreted as a 
population satisfaction rate.

Testimonials and reviews are experience evidence, not scientific 
efficacy evidence.

signals:
Referral or indication appeared frequently in this small analyzed payer 
sample.

Healthcare professionals appeared frequently among the referral sources 
in this sample.
limitations:
This is a small confirmed-payer sample and must not be treated as an 
acquisition estimate for the entire business.

Mention of indication inside WhatsApp is not automatically equivalent 
to the recorded acquisition source.

patient_language.usage_rule:
Use real patient language when it improves relevance or 
clarity, but never fabricate quotes and always de-identify patient information.

positioning_relevance.internal_principle:
A paciente chega por um sintoma. Eu enxergo o 
quadro.
positioning_relevance.interpretation:
Communication should demonstrate how relevant symptoms, 
history, findings and context can change interpretation, investigation and 
treatment decisions.
positioning_relevance.warning:
Do not imply that every symptom has one cause, that all patients 
have complex disease, or that other physicians failed.

content_implications.implication:
Create content that demonstrates clinical reasoning rather 
than relying mainly on declarations of authority.

Use patient-recognition content to attract relevant 
attention, then build understanding, trust and appropriate conversion across 
multiple pieces.

Paid-media creative may need stronger qualification and 
faster clarity because Meta leads were more price-first in the analyzed 
sample.
content_implications.validation_needed:
Compare creative, campaign, raw CRM behavior, 
confirmed appointments, attendance and verified revenue.

content_implications.implication:
Marketing may be able to reproduce part of the trust 
transfer created by referrals through reasoning, proof, clarity, resolutivity 
and shareable technical content.
content_implications.validation_needed:
Track acquisition source and downstream outcomes 
over time.

research_gaps.possible_collection:
Add a question such as: Já procurou outros 
profissionais por esse mesmo motivo?

Improve questionnaire coverage before estimating 
prevalence.

research_gaps.gap:
True lead-to-attendance and lead-to-revenue conversion by 
acquisition source
research_gaps.possible_collection:
Link CRM evidence with the internal attendance 
spreadsheet and authoritative financial records.

source_truth_rules.booking:
Observable raw CRM evidence meeting the operational booking 
definition
source_truth_rules.attendance:
Internal attendance spreadsheet or designated authoritative 
operational source
source_truth_rules.medical_claims:
Scientific Research using verifiable literature and 
guidelines

prohibited_inferences: Do not infer income or socioeconomic class without reliable data.

Do not claim that the typical patient has already seen three or more 
physicians.
Do not treat public reviews as a satisfaction-rate denominator.
Do not treat Cliente IO AI labels as ground truth.
Do not treat a confirmed WhatsApp appointment as verified attendance.
Do not treat quoted price as verified revenue.

Do not treat questionnaire symptom frequencies as prevalence in the general 
population.
Do not treat this synthetic example as a current audience report.

confidence.reasoning:
The structure combines established strategic decisions with 
observed signals from multiple internal datasets. Confidence must be assessed 
field by field because the sources answer different questions and have different 
denominators and limitations.

recommended_next_steps:
Continue linking audience observations to downstream booking, attendance 
and revenue evidence.
Improve questionnaire coverage for unresolved audience questions.

Keep observed facts, associations, hypotheses and strategic decisions 
explicitly separated.

Update this example when the Audience Intelligence output contract 
materially changes.
